ns2:course.label: Advanced Data Science and Python for Finance
ns2:course.description: Provides an advanced understanding of Python and data analytics tools to solve problems in finance. Students will analyze data and solve real-world problems such as investigating market responses to earnings announcements, comparing value and growth investing, forecasting stock prices, predicting bankruptcy, and estimating house prices. 2 graduate hours. No professional credit.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to MS: Finance Cost Rec - UIUC.
